sources.note: Pluggable 5.08 mm pitch screw-terminal blocks (Phoenix Contact class): no dimension of a specific part was verified. The model is a generic 8-pole block, 5.08 mm pitch, 42.64 x 15 x 20 mm (width = 8 x 5.08 + 2 mm), screw heads on top, wire entries on the back: every size is an ESTIMATE. The catalog gpio-terminal is a GPIO terminal block / D-sub logic port; the block was chosen.
